title: sweep(spec-surface): 5-item description-surface truth sweep — one claim, one PR, per-item checklist review (#6085 #6081 #6137 #6065 #5676)
body:
First bundled trivia sweep (maintainer 2026-08-07: PM coordinates same-class trivia into one card — economy of a drive-by fix WITHOUT losing the state machine). One dev, one claim, one PR closing all seven via multiple `Fixes` lines; review is a per-item checklist.

## Membership rule (why exactly these seven)

Same class: **spec description-surface text that lies or drifted** — JSDoc/describe/ledger prose corrections with ZERO open semantic forks (each is either truth-restoration or already ruled). No behavior changes; regen + existing pin conventions carry the verification.

## The seven (fix direction per item — each already carries an audit/triage comment)

| # | file | fix |
|---|---|---|
| #6085 ★ | `expression.zod.ts` dialect table (renders verbatim to the published ref page) | remove retired `js` row (says "mapping"), add missing `template`; align with the enum 12 lines below; regen; pin per retirement-docs convention |
| #6081 ★ | `stack.zod.ts:396` skills JSDoc | drop "trigger phrases for intent matching" copy — `triggerPhrases` retired in #3896; point authors at the current spelling; keep the existing pin test honest |
| #6161 | strictness ledger prose (`.md`, hand-written half) | the two `no gate` exemplars were re-verdicted (#5020/#5068); refresh the classification-table exemplars to current population (tree-wide `no gate` = 0) |
| #6137 | `theme.zod.ts` / `chart.zod.ts` | delete the two obsolete "no doc block above this" `//` warnings (#5059 made them wrong) |
| #6065 | `ApiEndpointSchema`/`ApiMappingSchema` `.describe()` ×3 | ruled 2026-08-07 direction B: pure describe copy — stop advertising whole-key rejection the publish gate doesn't do; vocabulary stays frozen (#5040) |
| #5676 | `DiscoverySchema.environment` (3) vs `EnvironmentTypeSchema` (7) | ruled remaining scope: docs cross-reference both ways + a subset pin test; explicitly NO contract change |
| #5886 | `packages/spec/src/data/hook.test.ts:422` | re-spell the insert fixture `input: { doc: … }` to the engine's real shape (spec half of #5671) |

**Excluded on same-file serialization**: #6094 (`flow.zod.ts` tombstone) collides with in-flight #4415 (flow schema family) — it rides the NEXT sweep after #4415 lands.

## Discipline

- ⛔ Nothing beyond the seven listed fixes — a sweep with riders defeats its own review model.
- Spec regen: the sweep touches TSDoc that feeds generated reference pages — expect `content/docs/references/**` regen. **Landing order**: in-flight #4415 also regenerates spec artifacts; whichever PR lands second follows the generated-artifacts resync four-step (merge main → checkout generated from main → commit the merge → full regen → assert sibling entries survived).
- PR body: per-item checklist mirroring the table, each with before/after one-liner.
- All seven members are assigned + marked "riding this sweep" — they close via the PR's `Fixes` lines.
